title: Power and Torque Performance
summary: Sampled feedback centers on the G70 being described as having strong, plentiful, and responsive power, while many other mentions simply note power without enough context to determine sentiment.

positive.summary: Positive reviews praise strong torque, responsive acceleration, and ample power across ICE, BEVE, and PHEV examples.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined reviews mention plenty of power or stopping power but do not provide enough evaluative context to classify the sentiment.

limitations: Many sampled fragments are short statements about power with limited context, so sentiment is often undetermined rather than explicitly evaluative.
One undetermined example refers to stopping power rather than propulsion power, which slightly broadens the topic beyond engine or acceleration performance.
